sources.fullCitation: Walter Jurmann, Ihre Majestät die Liebe, Tonfilm: “Du bist nicht die Erste!” Tango, for brass band (see Trara XI). Registered in Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht (July 1931): 152. Internet Archive scan, leaf n151.
sources.title: Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht: “Du bist nicht die Erste!”
sources.creator: Walter Jurmann
sources.publication: Trara XI (brass-band collection, as cross-referenced in the entry)
sources.researchNote: On p. 152 the entry “Jurmann, Walter” lists, from the sound film Ihre Majestät die Liebe, “Du bist nicht die Erste!” as a tango for brass band. The February issue (p. 35) lists the film’s Schlagerheft, including “Du bist nicht die erste”, under Jurmann as well. Kaper is named in neither entry.

works.title: Ihre Majestät die Liebe
works.publicNote: Bronisław Kaper’s involvement is considered probable, but his role is not established. The only positive attribution is IMDb, which lists him as “Benjamin Kapper”; Filmportal and the Walter Jurmann works catalogue do not confirm it. Hofmeisters Musikalisch-literarischer Monatsbericht registers the film’s song folio, with “Du bist nicht die erste”, “Mein Glück bist du” and three other songs, under Walter Jurmann alone (February 1931: 35), as it does a brass-band arrangement of “Du bist nicht die Erste!” (July 1931: 152). The film had its premiere at the Gloria-Palast in Berlin on 9 January 1931, before the Jurmann–Kaper collaboration began.
